rock.name: Wonewoc Formation (Cw)
rock.descrip: Quartz sandstone, medium grained, brownish yellow to white, with medium- to large-scale cross bedding commonly seen in outcrop. Reaches a maximum thickness of 165 feet (50 m) in the subsurface. Part of Elk Mound Group.

ancient_setting.confidence: inferred from rock type, so only 'probably'. Sandstone and conglomerate can also form in shallow seas.
